```sql
SELECT 
  degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_Centroid(p.geometry), h.geometry)) AS direction_degrees,
  CASE
    WHEN degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_Centroid(p.geometry), h.geometry)) BETWEEN 0 AND 22.5 OR degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_Centroid(p.geometry), h.geometry)) BETWEEN 337.5 AND 360 THEN 'North'
    WHEN degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_Centroid(p.geometry), h.geometry)) BETWEEN 22.5 AND 67.5 THEN 'Northeast'
    WHEN degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_Centroid(p.geometry), h.geometry)) BETWEEN 67.5 AND 112.5 THEN 'East'
    WHEN degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_Centroid(p.geometry), h.geometry)) BETWEEN 112.5 AND 157.5 THEN 'Southeast'
    WHEN degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_Centroid(p.geometry), h.geometry)) BETWEEN 157.5 AND 202.5 THEN 'South'
    WHEN degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_Centroid(p.geometry), h.geometry)) BETWEEN 202.5 AND 247.5 THEN 'Southwest'
    WHEN degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_Centroid(p.geometry), h.geometry)) BETWEEN 247.5 AND 292.5 THEN 'West'
    WHEN degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_Centroid(p.geometry), h.geometry)) BETWEEN 292.5 AND 337.5 THEN 'Northwest'
  END AS direction
FROM parks p
JOIN pois h ON h.geometry <-> ST_Centroid(p.geometry)
WHERE p.park_name ILIKE '%Oxbow Park%'
  AND ST_Intersects(p.geometry, (SELECT geometry FROM regions WHERE region_name ILIKE '%Byron%' LIMIT 1))
  AND h.amenity = 'hospital'
ORDER BY h.geometry <-> ST_Centroid(p.geometry)
LIMIT 1;
```
